description: Exotic LookML coverage. access_filter: the order_fact explore restricts ORDER_STATUS by the `allowed_status` user_attribute (row-level security) — now converted to a REAL Sigma RLS artifact: a boolean calc column `RLS: Order Status` = CurrentUserAttributeText("allowed_status") = [Order Status] on the order_fact element PLUS an element filter on that column (kind:list, mode:include, values:[true]) that fail-closes to only matching rows. The converter no longer claims RLS is UI-only; it emits an actionable informational warning to provision/reuse the Sigma user attribute. many_to_many: the promo_dim join is relationship: many_to_many; Sigma has no native M:N, so it is mapped to the closest type (N:1) with a bridge-table warning and the relationship + joined dimension columns are retained (no dangling refs, >=1 relationship). A correctly-handled model produces a real relationship, the RLS calc column + element filter, and zero error columns.
